prompts.name: generate_incident_postmortem
prompts.description: Synthesizes an enterprise P0/P1 post-mortem from incident logs and metrics.

arguments.name: incident_id
arguments.description: Unique identifier of the incident (e.g., INC-8841).

arguments.name: include_timeline
arguments.description: Whether to extract sub-second chronological traces (true/false).

prompts.name: refactor_clean_architecture
prompts.description: Generates a step-by-step refactoring plan to align legacy modules with Hexagonal Architecture.

arguments.name: target_module
arguments.description: Path to the module directory or file.
